translations.web: I didn’t send these prophets, yet they ran. I didn’t speak to them, yet they prophesied.
translations.bsb: I did not send these prophets, yet they have run with their message; I did not speak to them, yet they have prophesied.
translations.kjv: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
